head: 99b350cdf74c2b018b69daf719669ae53a5aafd5
claim: An app on the released @byokit/openclaw 0.28.1 can apply a Skill Workshop proposal while something else on the same install is writing the shared state database: the apply waits out the other writer and lands applied, instead of failing with "database is locked".

steps.start: a fresh isolated engine state directory, one member, one pending Workshop proposal
steps: Boot the pinned Gateway through the public kit and create and inspect a Workshop proposal for a member
Take the shared state database's write lock from a second connection and hold it 8 s
Apply the proposal through skills.proposals.apply while that lock is held
steps.result: the apply waits for the other writer and lands applied, with the proposal reading applied afterwards

verdicts.seen: I read all five capture lines: proposal pending; second writer holds BEGIN IMMEDIATE for 8000 ms in WAL; apply is applied with waitedMs 8251 and failedError null; after is applied with waitedPastBusyTimeout true. That matches waiting out the writer and landing applied rather than a lock failure.
